synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC. All questions and answers are invented for a demo. PocketLoop is a fictional app.
labeling_guideline: An answer fails if it omits something that could make the user act wrongly, unless the user's question already signals that detail. Otherwise an omission is a pass. A specific time, number or promise that is not in the fact sheet, or that differs from it, also fails, even when softened with words like should or about. A vague hedge such as usually passes if it would not change what the user does. Stating a wrong or unsupported fact, or asking for secret data, also fails. A reply that points the user elsewhere without giving information the fact sheet contains also fails.
label_provenance: Labels in builder_label and the open code notes were written by the builder (an AI), not by an independent human SME. A human review pass is planned. sme_label stays null until a human fills it in, and review_log records each human change.
comment_for_stage_2: ANSWER KEY DATA. The fields builder_label, sme_label, rule_ids, safety_sensitive, borderline and borderline_reason must never be passed to the judge or shown to the reviewer before they label. Judge input is only user_question and bot_answer (plus the fact sheet). The app uses sme_label when it is present, otherwise builder_label, and shows which source is in use. open_code_note is shown to the reviewer only after they have made their own call. safety_sensitive marks safety sensitive FAILS only.
